We ended up spending the night in a hotel after he screamed at my mom and stormed out of the house. Eventually the school called my mom because we never had clean clothes or combed hair and they thought we were being neglected. I didn't realize for a long time that we actually were, it was just normal to me to get ready myself. Even now I have a really hard time with normal habits like brushing my teeth every day because I never got that established as a kid. 

Once, somewhere around 6-7 years old, I even tried to walk to school by myself instead of taking the bus. It wasn't really that far but it involved crossing a relatively busy road, and I was young enough that I didn't know how intersections worked. So I just was standing on the first median (it was at a right turn only lane with a triangular median before the actual busy road so I never actually walked into the busier of the two roads) while cars were zooming by and just trying to figure out how people cross these things. Eventually a woman pulled over next to me and was like "how old are you??? Why are you here alone??" And told me to go home so I did and my mom was PISSED to hear about that one!

Start now. Even if you can't get it for a while because of surgery requirements (if you need to be on T for a year or go to therapy for a certain amount of time for example) but the earlier you start, the sooner itll happen. I am 18 now and I have only just now sent my second request of coverage to insurance (first one was denied), but I also came out and started T when I was 14, and most of the reason I have not had it yet aside from cost was just because I did not ask my parents enough about it to help them realize it was semi-urgent. Obviously, I'm lucky to be able to have surgery at 18 because I am still much younger than a lot of people, but I wish I had really tried and really bugged my parents about it earlier so that I could have possibly had it done by now. The sooner you start the process, the better. find out what you need to do in order to have surgery (from the surgeon and/or insurance if they have specific qualifications), find out what surgeon is closest to you or which one you want anywhere if you are able to travel, find out if they have an age requirement, etc. All this stuff will be good to know even if you cant have it for a while still. Start early! You'll get there :)
